rule.text: The first time someone shows up, he says simply who they are, like "Cyrus, king of Persia" or "Moses, Israel's leader."

rule.text: The rule against guessing the next words of a line (see below) applies to every passage, and to fill in the blank too. The blank tests meaning the baker can reason out, not wording they haven't seen.

human.problem: Stop 2 tells the farming picture (verses 23-29) but never asks what it means or why Isaiah tells it after the warning of judgment in stop 1. The baker may leave without seeing how the two halves of the passage connect. The text itself never states the connection.
human.question: prep-walkthrough.md says to ask "why the speaker says what he says," but the Scripture rules say not to add reasons or connections the text doesn't state.
